requirement: Return one clinical variable as a read-only projection: identity, type, unit, required flag, category, the rendered prerequisite formula, and the type-specific payload (numeric ranges, categorical accepted values); a missing id is reported as ResourceNotFound.

preconditions.text: The requested clinical variable exists and is live
The variable carries the type-specific payload or prerequisite seeded for the case
The requested id matches no live variable

inputs.text: Query for a categorical variable with accepted values
Query for a numeric variable with an accepted and a normal range
Query for a boolean variable without prerequisite
Query for a numeric variable with an unbounded accepted range
Query for a numeric variable without a normal range
Query for a variable that was soft deleted beforehand
Query for a variable whose prerequisite is a bare variable reference
Query for a variable with a nested prerequisite formula
Query for a variable whose prerequisite is a binary expression

returns.text: Success with the identity, type, unit, required flag, category, and rendered prerequisite
Numeric variables project both ranges, including an absent normal range
Categorical variables project their accepted values and no ranges
Boolean variables project neither type-specific payload
Failure with ResourceNotFound and a null payload

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing or soft-deleted variable is returned as a failed Result
